capabilities: Convert Markdown notes to HTML with embedded images
Upload the HTML document to the Arweave blockchain
Estimate transaction cost in AR tokens and USD
Check Arweave wallet balance before uploading
Embed images as base64 in the exported HTML
extras: The README warns that the wallet private key is stored in plaintext in settings, uploaded notes are publicly accessible and cannot be deleted, and only image attachments are currently supported.
motivation: The README frames the plugin as providing a decentralized, permanent storage solution that keeps notes accessible even if local or cloud storage fails.
problem: Obsidian notes live locally or in paid cloud services; there is no built-in way to store them permanently on decentralized infrastructure with a one-time fee.

requires.name: AR tokens to pay for storage

summary: Uploader that converts notes to HTML, including embedded images, and publishes them permanently to the Arweave decentralized storage network.
